title: Move to Allow Casino Operators’ to Increase their Approved Gaming Area
what_it_is: Move to Allow Casino Operators’ to Increase their Approved Gaming Area

sections.label: Questions on casino expansion approvals
sections.summary: Questions ask why gaming areas and machines were increased, whether stakeholders were consulted, and how land cost and tax revenue are handled.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry why the expansion of gaming areas for the two casinos by 2,000 square meters for Marina Bay Sands (MBS) and 500 square meters for Resorts World Sentosa (RWS) and the increase in gambling machines from 2,500 to 3,500 for MBS and 3,300 for RWS are necessary for the commercial viability of the proposed expansion of the Integrated Resorts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry (a) why did the Casino Regulatory Authority allow MBS and RWS to increase their approved gaming area by 13% and 3% respectively, and their slot machines by 40% and 34% respectively; and (b) prior to the approvals, were any stakeholders consulted in respect of the possible social implications on Singaporeans arising from the proposed increases and, if so, who were these stakeholders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry (a) how does the Government ensure that the land cost to be paid by the existing Integrated Resort (IR) operators is fair without calling for a public tender; (b) what is the estimated increase in tax revenue that both IRs are expected to generate with the additional investment; (c) whether the increase in tax revenue will be able to support the increased healthcare needs of Singaporeans; and (d) whether the increase in casino entry fees can be channelled to meet the increased healthcare needs of Singaporeans.

sections.label: Gaming area proportion falls
sections.summary: If both IRs take full additional gaming area, gaming area as a proportion of total floor area drops from 3% to 2.3%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: If both IRs exercise their options for additional gaming area in full, gaming area as a proportion of total floor area will drop from 3% today to 2.3%, as the expansion of the non-gaming area is much larger.

sections.label: Expected visitors and economic contribution
sections.summary: The expansion is expected to attract 500,000 more international visitors yearly and contribute S$500 million annually to Singapore's economy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Minister Desmond Lee has explained earlier how we are doing so in his reply to Mr Seah Kian Peng.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: These are expected to attract an additional 500,000 international visitors each year and contribute S$500 million annually to Singapore’s economy.

sections.label: Marina Bay Sands expansion site
sections.summary: The Marina Bay Sands expansion site is 3.3 hectares at a cost of $1.3 billion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The expansion site for Marina Bay Sands is 3.3 hectares, at a cost of $1.3 billion.

sections.label: Land cost by Chief Valuer
sections.summary: Land cost will be determined by the Chief Valuer based on market value, which the IRs will pay.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Land cost will be determined by the Chief Valuer based on the market value.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The IRs will pay the fair market value as determined by the Chief Valuer.
